title: Non-null ruled surfaces and pseudo hyper-dual tangent sphere bundles
summary: In this paper, the tangent bundles of hyper-dual pseudo spheres are defined. Then, a new family of non-null ruled surfaces associated with hyper-dual Lorentzian curves is defined via the E.Study hyper-map in Minkowski space and the definitions of the tangent bundles of hyper-dual pseudo spheres. Within this framework, the resulting non-null ruled surfaces are classified. Necessary and sufficient conditions for developability are obtained with their geometric interpretations in terms of hyper-dual Lorentzian curves and arc-length parameters.
